description: Natural-request control for the Bot activity bubble. Same inline seeds as catalog.json, but the user asks only the task and where the material is: no 10-20 character progress instruction, no fixed two-read sequence, no output-format instruction. This separates default-prompt behavior from the guided catalog. Tools are not constrained; the receipt verifies the real session used read or bash to read the seed.
